title: Somatosensory population co-smoothing
scientific_question: How well do visible somatosensory neurons predict withheld spikes during active and perturbed reaches, evaluated separately under the same frozen preparation and split?
primary_outputs: Observed held-out-unit spike counts on fixed 600 msmovement-onset windows for the declared evaluation rows.

data_manifest.prepared_split_warning: Train/test NWBs and MC_Maze Large/Medium/Small variants are derived releases of a source acquisition, not independent datasets.

recording_contract.neural: Actual NWB header confirms units/spike_times with ragged spike_times_index, heldout-unit flags and observation intervals;65units in the inspected training file. Unit labels are not persistent identities across other sessions.
recording_contract.labels: Actual training NWB contains826trial-table rows and columns bump_dir, bump_time, cond_dir, ctr_hold, ctr_hold_bump, go_cue_time, id, move_onset_time, result, split, start_time, stop_time, target_dir, target_on_time. Hand position/velocity are timestamped behavioral arrays. Additional labels must be masked when they are prediction targets.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Sorted spike timestamps and trial/event times are aligned in the NWB time base. Official NWBDataset bins spikes on a1ms grid and resamples for5ms/20ms benchmarks; MC_Maze behavior uses timestamps, Area2 uses starting_time/rate. Rate values and unit conversion still need acquisition qualification.

biological_ids.session_description: Data from monkey Han performing center-out active-passive task. This file contains several continuous segments of the full session on 2017-12-07 that can be used for training models for the Neural Latents Benchmark.

recording_contract.evidence: Direct published asset URL inspected with bounded HTTP ranges; HDF5 names/shapes and identity metadata only, not neural/behavior values.

primary.name: active_and_perturbed_Poisson_co_bps
primary.aggregation: Two condition-specific pooled likelihood scores; recompute the per-unit evaluation-mean null separately within each condition. Keep both endpoints, do not collapse to a favorable condition.
primary.rationale: Measures prediction in both source conditions without conflating unequal spike totals or a pooled null with condition-wise performance.

secondary: Pooled official-equation co-bps as a separate diagnostic, not average of subgroup scores.
Signed differences versus training-mean and source-derived smoothing/Poisson controls; condition trial/unit support.

comparators.name: training_mean
comparators.procedure: Implemented training per-unit mean predictor; distinct from evaluation-derived metric null.

comparators.name: nlb_smoothing_poisson
comparators.inputs: Training visible/withheld counts and query visible counts only.
comparators.procedure: Implemented source-derived 30 ms Gaussian/log-count features and PoissonRegressor(alpha 0.01) per withheld unit with native integer-bin recipe; failed convergence/missing input is explicit.

nuisance_controls: Use exact source heldout mask and ctr_hold_bump 0 active/1 perturbed mapping; authentication remains required.
Separate continuous train/eval blocks and nonoverlapping windows.
Preserve missingness/exclusions independent of predictions and all heldout-unit coverage per condition.
evaluation.uncertainty: Descriptive complete-trial/block comparisons in one session; cannot obtain independent animal replication by resampling units or bins.
evaluation.failure_policy: Reject extra fields, wrong masks/IDs/units, malformed outputs or uncovered condition units. Finite nonnegative rates required; exact zeros become 1e-9 as in pinned official metric, unlike 017/018 strict positivity. All-zero target totals are explicitly undefined.
